patterns.name: Full-width editorial section field
patterns.intent: Keep the news module open and editorial rather than presenting it as a dashboard card.
observableRules: white field spans the viewport
no rounded outer shell
no inset section card
next contrasting red section begins directly below
suitableFor: homepage editorial/news gallery with a strong following-section boundary

patterns.name: Responsive editorial header
patterns.intent: Pair a forceful editorial label with an always-discoverable but secondary archive route.
observableRules: desktop: 48px Kanit 700 italic heading left and archive link right in one row
mobile: 32px Kanit 700 italic centered heading and centered archive link below
archive link: PT Sans 18px 800 italic
suitableFor: a faithful generative proof of the same news pattern

patterns.name: Image-first news card
patterns.intent: Let recognizable campaign/editorial art carry the story before concise title and action copy.
observableRules: reading order is image, centered headline, centered CTA
source image ratio 578:325 is preserved without crop
desktop headline is PT Sans 24px/31.2px 800
mobile headline is PT Sans 20px/26px 800
card shadow is rgba(0,0,0,0.2) 0 6px 10px
notFor: image assets with incompatible ratios unless separately translated

patterns.name: Breakpoint-specific carousel density
patterns.intent: Preserve editorial readability by changing the number of visible stories, not by proportionally shrinking the desktop pair.
observableRules: desktop shows two equal cards with a 24px gutter and groups six stories into three pages
mobile shows one edge-to-edge card and maps six stories to six pages
pagination count corresponds to page count at the active breakpoint
suitableFor: responsive news carousel using the same six-story content model

patterns.name: Decisive black news action
patterns.intent: Provide a compact, high-contrast endpoint after each headline.
observableRules: desktop action has an observed 56px height and 20px 700 italic label
mobile action is centered at 173.4x51.3 with an 18px 700 italic label
resting state is black with white text
hover visibly changes text from white to black
suitableFor: news-card detail action in this carousel
unresolved: exact animated hover background layer color and shape

patterns.name: Directional carousel swap
patterns.intent: Make story replacement unmistakable while retaining directional continuity.
observableRules: opacity changes over 0.4s
outgoing content translates toward the navigation direction and fades
incoming content fades in from a slightly reduced scale and settles at center/scale 1
the final image, headline, and CTA identities are different
desktop advances a pair; mobile advances one story
suitableFor: user-triggered previous/next navigation in the WHAT'S NEW carousel

patterns.name: Edge navigation and localized page emphasis
patterns.intent: Keep navigation obvious at the content boundary while leaving the story center visually quiet.
observableRules: mobile edge controls are black 60x60 squares
disabled previous state is 0.5 opacity
six centered mobile dots represent six single-story pages
yellow appears as a localized carousel state/control emphasis, not a section or global action color
suitableFor: WHAT'S NEW carousel navigation and current-page feedback

patterns.name: Staggered viewport entry candidate
patterns.intent: Possible progressive reveal of title, cards, and CTA, but the exact visual behavior is not yet proved.
observableRules: settled nodes expose vp-slide and vp-pop states
computed transform duration is 0.5s with an overshoot cubic-bezier
computed opacity duration is 0.4s
title and CTA expose 0.6s and 0.8s delays

notes: Yellow is restricted to evidence-backed carousel emphasis.
Translated Chinese wrapping was not encoded as a typography or layout rule.
No exact entry-on-scroll trajectory was approved.
